visual_review.got: 8s loading panel; 25s PlayStation logo; 80s and 110s Continue menu with dark sword/foreground silhouettes. Incomplete rendering is not accepted. 110s overlay 11 FPS / 91.1 ms, a menu sample, not gameplay performance. The previously reported moving corner artifact is not reproduced in these menu frames.
visual_review.gow: 8s loading panel; 25s and 80s Santa Monica logo; 110s Continue menu. Overlay 12 FPS / 80.0 ms. No gameplay/cutscene reached in the supplied screenshots.
visual_review.corner_diagnosis: Nine GoT small-pass records use full 2048x2048 attachments and guest-defined 64x64 or 43x22 viewport/scissor regions; they do not show the full scene redirected to the upper-left display. Subresource mip/layer samples are active. A 64x64 uncompressed view against a 256x256 compressed backing can have the same block dimensions; MipOf/SliceOf explicitly account for this, so raw width ratio alone is not a confirmed mip-selection bug.

remaining_findings.evidence: 3 GoT warnings; AddOffset still returns without applying a nonconstant offset to unsupported sample instructions.
remaining_findings.status: Known unresolved semantics; no newly established correction in this menu run. Requires a correct universal lowering and validation, not suppressing the warning.

remaining_findings.issue: SHARP provenance and descriptor table sizing
remaining_findings.evidence: GoT 264 and GoW 140 SharpLocationFromSource warnings. GoT six indexed-table diagnostics and four descriptor-pool sizing warnings.
remaining_findings.status: Retained limitations; no SRT rejection, descriptor allocation failure or new fatal event observed. Not declared harmless or solved.

remaining_findings.issue: GPU image coherence and small render regions
remaining_findings.evidence: Five copy-layer coercions per title; GoT subresource mapping exercised; three initial stencil uploads, more GoW uploads.
remaining_findings.status: Array growth copies the common layer range; warning alone is not proof of discarded live layers. Native visuals and active depth/stencil readback limitations remain unverified.

remaining_findings.evidence: GoW 1653 SetQueueReg offset 0xb warnings; 2800 original-GCN first-pass completion records.
remaining_findings.status: Queue support gap and previously observed cost remain open. Completion records are diagnostic progress; no full-run CPU performance samples in this GPU-trace mode.

remaining_findings.evidence: 3382 GoW stdout warnings that destination appears uncached/write-combined.
remaining_findings.status: Prior performance clue; not proof that host mappings are actually uncached. No warning-suppression workaround.

remaining_findings.issue: Missing dumped resources and optional file lookups
remaining_findings.evidence: Both titles lack dumped system fonts and trophy data. GoW four missing .toc/.wypsm paths, including mid_chase100_intro.wypsm.
remaining_findings.status: Missing files cannot be repaired by fabricating resources or declaring all probes fatal. Verify the user game/system dump separately if relevant.

remaining_findings.evidence: All runtime warning/error locations are listed per run, including initial linker warnings.
remaining_findings.status: Remain incomplete; no new pre-menu fatal dependency established. Does not claim all logged stubs implemented.
